title: Geographical Sources of Information and Services: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
unitTitle: Geographical Sources of Information and Services
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A, AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Describe the types of products created during a geographic information system application.
Discuss the seven components of a geographic information system.
Discuss five resources required for implementation of a geographic information system in an organization.
Discuss five factors to consider when selecting a suitable software for library / Information centre automation.
Discuss the following concepts in relation to geographic information system data analysis.
Describe the rationale for automating libraries and information centres.
Explain five aspects that need to be considered during the process of planning for an automation project.
Discuss five aspects to consider in evaluation of hardware when putting up the system in place.
Discuss five factors to consider when selecting a storage media and devices for a geographic information system.
